mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id, c.user1_id, c.user2_id, c.last_message_id, c.updated_at, c.unread_count1, c.unread_count2, m.content as lastMessageContent, CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{userId} THEN u2.username ELSE u1.username END as otherUserName, CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{userId} THEN u2.avatar_url ELSE u1.avatar_url END as otherUserAvatar FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN users u1 ON c.user1_id = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON c.user2_id = u2.user_id LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.last_message_id = m.message_id WHERE c.user1_id = #{userId} OR c.user2_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
